title: Targeting
content_data:
We provide various targeting options for you to pinpoint the exact audiences you want your ads to be displayed to. The targeting options are set at the ad group level.

- [Audience targeting](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739381236849665)
- [Contextual targeting](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1745292519923713)
